Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible Reputed manufacturer/sole agent as mentioned below as further detailed in the
Tender Data Sheet (TDS) as well as Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
a) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the electro--mechanical works shall be five (05) years
for all lot/Package.
b) The minimum specific experience of the Contractor(s) at least 01 (One) contract of Supply and Installation of Lift successfully
completed within the last five (5) years with a value of at least Tk. 335.00 Lac only for each lot/Package Government/Semi-
Government/ Autonomous Bodies / Private within Bangladesh.
c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 383.00 Lac only for
each lot individually [Document submitted along with the Tender must be issued in between Publication date & Submission date of
the Tender.]
d) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC category Contractor & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh Electrical Licensing
Board.
e) The Tenderer must have up to date Income Tax clearance Certificate from the NBR with TIN up- to- 2015-2016.
f) The Tenderer must have up- to- date VAT Registration Certificate.
g) The Tenderer must have up- to- date valid Trade License.
